label: copy-phase input "1" (mid-sequence, before a c/z output)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never during original tokens or at <DEL>), almost exclusively when the fed-back input is the digit 1 (93% of activation mass; small remainder on inputs z and c). Strongest when the 1 was original token 2-3 (recall_idx 3-4, t around 11-13) and when the token being output next is c or z (top examples are all 1 followed by c/z, e.g. ... 1 c c ...); sequences with more digits fire more often. It is sparse even on its trigger: only about 22% of copy-phase 1 inputs at recall_idx>=3 fire, and late-sequence 1s (last outputs) usually do not. Does not fire on 1 during the original phase, or on 1 at recall_idx 0-2. Predicate captures ~91% of mass but has low precision; the extra gating (output identity c/z, position) is real but not cleanly capturable.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: 1, z, c, f, 2, 0; least: l, u, g, y) and the token being output (most: c, z, 1, 3, v, 2; least: p, u, g, -); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=3, recall_idx=4, t=12.
